node.statement: Smallness arithmetic and dependency ledger. With the explicit extra premise epsilon<=e_0/2 and a_merge=e_0/2, rho<=a_merge gives rho+epsilon<=e_0. Requiring validation of 1.1.1 and 1.1.2 supplies the two block bijections used in the level-one factorization; requiring validation of 1.2 and 1.3 supplies respectively the amplified homomorphism and two-sided norm estimates. Their maximum constant C_merge=max{K_hom,K_norm,3} therefore yields the conditional extended-isomorphism conclusion. Without the extra epsilon premise, epsilon is unrestricted by the registered definitions and the implication rho<=a_merge => rho+epsilon<=e_0 is false; hence the original root cannot be concluded by this route.
